title: Projektetage Catalogue Grid Fidelity
description: Bauteilkatalog tile grid looks different from the original bauteilbörse.png. Full catalogue figure must use the same stretch-to-frame rendering as split tiles, not object-fit cover on img.
summary: Implemented general mosaic tiling via mosaicWindowedCoverVars: each grid cell is a window onto one cover of the mosaic frame (columns×100% auto on wide slides, not per-crop sprite zoom). Added overflowAxisPosition, PresentationSlideAspectContext, routed mosaic rest/grid through windowed cover regardless of morphTo; morph vars stay centered crop. Fixed figureCropBackgroundVars param naming (morphToFrame). Renderer 102 tests + core 43 tests pass.
